text.p: Compass Bancshares, Inc. has a definitive agreement to acquire Horizon Bancorp, Inc. and its subsidiary, Horizon Bank & Trust, SSB. in a stock deal valued at about $34 million, the companies said Thursday.
Birmingham, Ala.-based Compass will offer 888,889 shares of its common stock for all of Horizon's 1.4 million shares of outstanding common stock and options.
Assuming all options are exercised, Compass will exchange 0.5629 share of its stock for each Horizon common share.
The acquisition will add $143 million in assets, $129 million in deposits and eight bank branches to Compass in Texas, the companies said.

"We've made no secret of wanting to be in Austin because of its strong diversified and growing economy," said Compass Chairman D. Paul Jones Jr. "The acquisition will add value to our franchise and allow us to compete in another important Texas market."
The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, subject to shareholder and regulatory approval, the companies said.

With this acquisition and the pending purchase of Greater Brazos Valley Bancorp, Inc. in Bryan/College Station and locations under construction, Compass will exceed $5.0 billion in Texas assets and operate 101 offices throughout the state.
Compass is an $11.6 billion banking company with 208 bank offices and 4,300 employees in Alabama, Florida and Texas.
Horizon's stock rose 75 cents to $18, while Compass fell 31.25 cents to $38 on Nasdaq at midday.
